messages:
Alex (product): Heads-up: post-launch follow-up for "Metrics Dashboard v2". Need to decide bug vs enhancement triage and scope for next sprint. Can we sync? @Maya @Samir
Maya (eng): Quick context: rollout had small NPE on low-RAM nodes, and some UI perf regressions. I captured stack traces in #incidents.
Samir (sre): NPE affects ~0.6% of calls, auto-retry covers some. Ops prefers patch before next canary.
Evan (design): Users also flagged the chart legend as confusing; easy tweak but impacts usability.
Jordan (cs): Customer A is asking for filtering by user role — they consider it high priority for adoption.
Alex (product): Proposal: critical bugs (NPE, perf >250ms p95) go into hotfix in next 2-week sprint. UX tweaks + filter by role as planned enhancements in 2-step: quick-filter MVP then full filter.
Maya (eng): Agree on hotfix. For filter by role — backend change touches auth -> needs 2 engineers ~3 dev-days + tests.
Samir (sre): If we schedule hotfix, we should freeze non-critical deploys for 48h after release.
Evan (design): UX: quick legend tweak + tooltip is 1 day. Full filter needs mockups.
Jordan (cs): Sales: Customer A will accept MVP filter if ETA under 3 weeks. Can we commit?
Alex (product): Decision needed: do we take Customer A's MVP into next sprint or backlog? Votes?
Maya (eng): Vote: take hotfix + MVP backend for filter (1 eng) — balance risk.
Samir (sre): Vote: hotfix only; leave MVP for next sprint after monitoring.
Evan (design): Vote: hotfix + legend tweak + MVP frontend prototype.
Jordan (cs): Vote: include MVP — it's customer-facing and likely to close deal.
Alex (product): Consensus lean: hotfix + MVP minimal backend + front legend tweak. Action items: Maya to lead hotfix, Evan to ship legend change, Maya+Evan handoff for MVP API contract. Jordan to confirm Customer A with conditional ETA. Samir to set post-deploy freeze policy.
Maya (eng): I'll open PRs: hotfix branch `hotfix/metrics-npe` (target merge by EOD Thu). I'll include unit + smoke tests.
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary deploy for hotfix -> 1719080000. Reminder: run rollback playbook if error_rate > 0.5%.
Alex (product): I'll update the roadmap doc and notify sales. Acceptance criteria: NPE rate <0.1%, p95 latency <200ms, no new regressions on core queries.
Samir (sre): I'll add temporary alert: `ALERT if error_rate(metrics) > 0.2%` and create rollback runbook snippet:
```
# rollback
kubectl rollout undo deployment/metrics-dashboard
notify #incidents
```
Jordan (cs): I'll confirm Customer A that we'll target MVP in next sprint if we hit the hotfix timeline. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Evan (design): I'll drop mockups in Figma and share link. Quick legend + tooltip patch will go to QA tomorrow.
Alex (product): OK, closing thread — will sync in async doc. If anyone blocks, ping me. :checkered_flag:
